_about: Learned live on amazon.com search pages on 2026-10-28 (scratch/amazon/probe_search.py). Cards carry data-asin and data-cy sections - Amazon's own stable hooks, not generated classes. Product-page locators learned 2026-10-28 (scratch/amazon/probe_product.py, probe_buybox.py) once the extension could read product pages (execute_script falls back to chrome.scripting where the debugger is refused).

search_box.name: Search Amazon
search_box.description: Global search input in the header; on every Amazon page. type_cdp finds it by the xpath (clicks it, clears, types).

search_submit.name: Go
search_submit.description: The header search button (input type=submit). Clicked with a trusted CDP click after typing the query.
search_submit.notes: user-supplied absolute XPath /html/body/div[1]/header/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div/form/div[3]/div/span/input - same element, registered by its id (absolute XPaths break on layout changes)

deliver_to.description: Delivery location shown in the header (city + ZIP) - prices and delivery dates are for this address. Read only; never changed.

result_card.description: One search result; data-asin is the product id.

card_title.description: Brand line (sponsored cards and 'Amazon Renewed') + product title.

card_price.description: Featured offer price. Missing when the card says 'See options' or has no featured offer.

card_list_price.description: Struck-through 'List:' / was price; only on discounted items.

card_delivery.description: 'FREE delivery Tomorrow, Oct 29', '$9.99 delivery Nov 24 - Dec 4', 'Only 7 left in stock', 'Temporarily out of stock'.

card_secondary_offer.description: 'More Buying Choices $439.45(12+ used & new offers)' - the lowest other offer, condition not stated.

card_prime.name: Prime
card_prime.description: Prime badge on a search card (aria-label 'Prime'). Absent = not Prime. 'FREE delivery ... for Prime members' is a different signal (prime_only_free).

next_page.description: Next page link (href has page=N); absent on the last page.

no_results.description: 'No results for your search query.' - e.g. nothing in the price range.

captcha_form.description: Amazon's robot check. Stops the run for the human; never solved or bypassed.

human_check.description: Amazon's 'I am human' checkbox checkpoint (seen 2026-10-30). The person ticks it; the script only waits, never clicks it.

product_asin.description: The page's ASIN (hidden input) - evidence the page is the requested product.

product_availability.description: Availability line: 'In Stock', 'Only 1 left in stock - order soon.', 'Currently unavailable.', 'Temporarily out of stock.' Not enough alone: a page can say 'In stock' with no buy button.

add_to_cart.description: Featured (new / renewed) offer's Add to Cart. Presence = it can be bought. READ ONLY - NEVER clicked.

add_to_cart_used.description: Add to Cart of a USED buy box ('Buy Used: $198.22', 'Used: Very Good' - live on B07QC8RSZB, whose card had no price). READ ONLY - NEVER clicked.
add_to_cart_used.notes: #usedOfferListingID is NOT a used signal: the hidden input is also on pages whose featured offer is new (B0CTK1SFVD, sold by Amazon.com)

see_all_offers.description: 'See All Buying Options': no featured offer - no single price to track.

buybox.description: The buy box (offer type, condition, seller, availability).

core_price.description: Buy box price to pay ('$399.97'; priceToPay reads '$399 . 97' - spaces are removed before parsing).

selected_variant.description: The selected option in the inline variation menu (data-asin = that variant). Its own price is the real price of what the page sells.
selected_variant.notes: user-supplied absolute XPath /html/body/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[6]/div[4]/div[23]/div[1]/div[3]/div/div/div/div[2]/div/div points inside this item (the swatch's price block); registered by Amazon's own ids/attributes because absolute XPaths break on layout changes

variant_price.description: Selected option's price to pay ('$25.99'). The a-offscreen span inside is EMPTY here; the aria-hidden span holds the price.

variant_availability.description: Option availability (' In Stock'), hidden text.

variant_prime.description: Prime badge slot of the option (hidden ms3slot); absent = that option is not Prime.

buybox_prime.description: Visible Prime badge by the price / in the buy box (Amazon.com-sold B0CTK1SFVD: yes; third-party renewed B0BK36KLDD: no).
